Detail:
The implement phase cannot converge slice-8. Slices 1-7 progressed normally (clean propose/ACK/confirm cycles; the 06:56-07:06 NACKs were legitimate, precise review findings). Slice-8 has been stalled since ~07:26.

Timeline of the slice-8 stall:

- 18:49: operator RESOLVED cq-1 (slice-1 recovery cherry-picked as a181d3f5, already pushed to egg/issue-3523/slice-8). Root-cause pipeline defect tracked separately as #3541.
- 18:53: slice-8 documenter pod reported an empty EGG_REPO_PATH / no checkout (host-side provisioning failure).
- 21:04 & 21:39: orchestrator auto-alerts — slice-8 CODER noop-streak (=3) and propose pending 1802s, no in-flight job.

Current state (verified 21:37-21:43, live): all HITL decisions are resolved (decision-1/2/3, cq-1 = 0 pending). The slice-8 coder pod IS alive and doing real LLM work — context-measure heartbeats with cache_hit 0.92-0.99 — so this is NOT the earlier empty-checkout failure. Instead the coder repeatedly derives EGG_EVENT_ACTION=propose for slice-8, runs, and exits WITHOUT ever emitting a CONSENSUS_PROPOSE (only 'one-shot event handler action=propose' + 'in-tool-loop liveness' heartbeats, no proposal). The coder appears to have no coder-owned task in slice-8, but — unlike slice-1, where it correctly emitted no_changes_needed — its slice-8 event arm is not closing the edge with a no-op proposal. So the orchestrator keeps re-deriving action=propose and re-spawning the (correctly idle) coder.

Operator intervention required — the phase will not self-recover. 1) Inspect the slice-8 coder's derived event: if the coder has no task in slice-8, inject/allow a coder no_changes_needed proposal for slice-8 (as it did for slice-1) so the coder BRC edge closes; if the event-loop is mis-deriving action=propose for a task-less coder, correct that derivation. 2) Confirm the slice-8 documenter (task-8-1) actually landed docs/reference/review-quality.md against the recovered criteria files (a181d3f5) and closed its edge — earlier that pod hit an empty-checkout failure, so verify it was re-spawned with a host-provisioned checkout including a181d3f5. 3) Once both producer edges close, slice-8 consensus should converge and the implement phase can complete.
